title: Case Prompting to Mitigate Large Language Model Bias for ICU Mortality Prediction

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model discrimination disparity (AUC-ROC), Group Fairness Assessment via Equal Opportunity Difference (EOD) based on false negative rates, and implicit feature dependency analysis comparing the consistency of the model's decision-making logic between male and female patient subgroups.
